check_box.label: Enable the local assistant bridge

check_box.tool_tip: Turn the loopback Event API on or off while this viewer is open. This does not launch an MCP client.

panel.text: This does not launch the MCP client. The sidecar must already be configured. After the first enable, the port stays open until you quit. Another program running as this user can read the discovery file while the switch is on. The discovery file can exist at the login screen, before inventory is usable.

panel.name: local_assistant_rows
panel.text: Move no-copy items during a copy
Trash can be restored. The default is Allow, with no dialog, matching today. This is not permanent delete. Permanent delete is not offered.
Moving a no-copy item still changes the only copy's location. Restore stays on this row. It is a move out of Trash, so Ask or Never on Trash does not apply to it.
Allow moves unique items out of the source with no dialog.
